text:
Maria (Support): Hey team — customer acct_9f2 reports a big reserved-GPU hours charge on their last invoice but their token usage is near zero for the same window. Invoice line item shows 48 GPU-hrs on Dedicated pool 'eu-west-2-primary'. Can we triage?

Jon (Billing): Thanks Maria. Do we have the invoice number and the committed pool id? Also any sample request ids or timestamps the customer shared?

Maria (Support): Invoice #INV-2026-3045, pool id pool:ded-eu-1, customer says pattern started after a failover at ~2165409000. They sent a couple request ids but they show low token_count. Repro steps they provided: small health-check pings from their app every 10s to keep connection warm.

Kevin (Eng): Can you paste the metering events for that pool around the failover window? I'm suspicious warmup instances are being billed as reserved hours without token attribution.

Maria (Support): grabbing events now — running the metering query:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $METER_KEY" \"https://metering.redwood.dev/v1/events?account=acct_9f2&pool=pool:ded-eu-1&start=2165406000&end=2165432400\"
```

metering-bot: query results summary: total_events=312, gpu_hours_charged=48.03, token_count=42, event_types=[request, pool_warmup, heartbeat]

Maria (Support): excerpt from events (sanitized):
```json
[
  {"ts":2165409121,"type":"pool_warmup","instance":"i-warmup-17","gpu_hours":8.0,"tokens":0},
  {"ts":2165409181,"type":"pool_warmup","instance":"i-warmup-18","gpu_hours":8.0,"tokens":0},
  {"ts":2165410003,"type":"request","instance":"i-active-03","gpu_hours":0.12,"tokens":22},
  {"ts":2165413600,"type":"heartbeat","instance":"i-active-03","gpu_hours":0.01,"tokens":0}
]
```

Kevin (Eng): That looks like warmup instances (type=pool_warmup) are accruing full GPU-hour accounting but not being excluded from invoice mapping to token usage. Two warmup instances at ~8 hrs each explains most of the delta. Possible triggers: failover caused autoscaler to spin warmup(s) then never tear down, or warmup tagging not marked as non-billable in the metering pipeline.

Jon (Billing): If warmup events are recorded as billable GPU-hours, invoice will reflect it. We need to map those event tags to invoice line items. Maria — can you pull the raw metering export for the invoice period so I can map event_ids -> line_item_ids?

Maria (Support): Export started, attaching CSV link (internal): https://internal.redwood/files/exports/acct_9f2/INV-2026-3045-metering.csv 

metering-bot: export ready, filename=INV-2026-3045-metering.csv, rows=312

Kevin (Eng): Actionable next steps from eng side: 1) check autoscaler logs around 2165409000 for failover path and ensure warmup instances are torn down; 2) audit metering pipeline to ensure events with type=pool_warmup have "billable":false or are attributed to maintenance SKU rather than dedicated commit; 3) add short-term rule to not count warmup instances >0 tokens as reserved burn until we patch.

Jon (Billing): From billing side, if metering audit confirms warmup misattribution, we can propose a one-off invoice credit for the customer and file a follow-up for SLA credit consideration. Please include exact GPU-hour amounts to credit.

Maria (Support): Customer wants ETA for resolution and whether we can credit the warmup hours proactively. I'll hold on official promise until we confirm.

Kevin (Eng): I can reproduce warmup behavior in a small test pool. Quick mitigation: set warmup TTL to 10m and mark warmup instances with label "maintenance=true" in metering emitter. I'll push a patch to infra branch and ask ops for a hotfix rollout.

Jon (Billing): If patch lands, billing can apply provisional credit and reconcile after final metering rerun. Maria — ask customer for their preferred contact and mention we're investigating cause + potential credit.

Maria (Support): Noted. I'll update customer + collect any extra timestamps they have. Opening internal incident INC-2026-721 and linking this thread.

Kevin (Eng): tagging @ops for rollout once PR is approved.

Maria (Support): thanks. cc @jon (Billing) — I'll attach invoice mapping once export is validated. :thumbsup:

Jon (Billing): Thanks all. Keep me posted on exact GPU-hours to credit (looks ~48.03 from summary).

Maria (Support): Closing interim loop with customer: "We've identified probable warmup-instance billing during a failover. We're validating and will propose credit within 24h." Customer replied :exclamation: "please do" and asked for SLA credit details.

Kevin (Eng): Will follow up in INC-2026-721 with root-cause and PR link.

metering-bot: note: scheduled job metering-cleanup-run at 2165520000 will reprocess events if flagged.

Maria (Support): OK locking action items: [Maria] update customer, [Kevin] PR + test, [Jon] prepare provisional credit, [Ops] hotfix rollout. We'll reconvene in the incident channel after metering reprocess. :white_check_mark:
